title: Tasting Like Itself
subtitle: When food needs help tasting like itself.
description: Flavourings are added to intensify or restore taste lost during industrial processing. Natural or artificial — they signal that the base ingredients no longer taste as they should.
why_body: Real food does not need flavourings. When a product lists 'natural flavouring' or 'flavour enhancer', it means the original ingredients were processed to the point where their natural taste was lost — and had to be added back artificially. According to NOVA (FAO, 2019), flavourings are a defining marker of ultra-processed food.
what_body: BOTIA detects flavour enhancers and artificial flavourings: monosodium glutamate (E621), yeast extract, hydrolyzed protein, natural flavouring, artificial flavouring, and smoke flavourings. Natural flavouring is particularly opaque — it can come from animals, plants, or fermentation, and the label does not say which.
can_1: Detect flavour enhancers and artificial flavourings declared on the label.
can_2: Flag 'natural flavouring' as an ingredient of undeclared origin.
can_3: Signal ultra-processed food markers based on NOVA classification.
cannot_1: Determine the exact source of natural flavourings — only the manufacturer knows.
cannot_2: Tell you whether flavourings affect you personally.
closing: Natural flavouring is one of the most opaque declarations on a food label. For Muslim Choice implications, see the Muslim module.
robot_answers: Flavourings are used to intensify, modify or restore flavour, especially after processing. Their presence indicates that part of the flavour comes from an added formulation.

"Natural" describes the category of flavouring; it does not mean the product is minimally processed or that the label reveals its exact source. It may come from animal or plant raw materials, or from fermentation processes.

NOVA considers flavourings one of the markers of an ultra-processed formulation. Even so, BOTIA does not assign a complete NOVA group to the product on its own because it does not know everything about how it was made.
